description: Answer why one specific file was ranked where it was, or left out of a plan entirely. Use this when a file you expected is missing from fixmap_plan, or when a ranked file looks wrong: it separates the cases that actually differ — ranked, scored below the cutoff, tied but outside the reported limit, deliberately excluded, or never scanned — instead of leaving you to guess. Needs a local checkout, because it re-ranks the repository rather than reading a saved report.

base.description: Base git ref to diff against when diff is not given

diff.description: Git diff spec, such as main...HEAD

exclude.description: The same exclusion patterns used for the plan

format.description: Output format: markdown (default) or json, case-insensitive

head.description: Head git ref, defaults to HEAD

issue.description: The same task signal used for the plan, so the explanation matches that ranking

noCache.description: Bypass the exact-state repository scan cache

path.description: Repository-relative path to explain, such as "src/auth/reset-password.ts"

repo.description: Local repository path, defaults to the server working directory. Remote URLs are not supported.

workingTree.description: Explain against staged and unstaged tracked changes, matching a working-tree plan

name: fixmap_explain
title: FixMap explain
